newsitem.title: UK: Prudential 9 mths single, regular sales rise.
newsitem.headline: Prudential 9 mths single, regular sales rise.

text.p: UK-based life assurance giant Prudential Corporation Plc said on Wednesday that single contribution life, pension and investment product sales rose 70 percent to 5,027 million stg during the first nine months.
Regular contribution sales grew 13 percent to 377 million stg, the company said in a statement.
In the UK, single contribution sales were up 80 percent to 2,783 million stg. Regular rose 9.0 percent to 229 million stg.
"We are delighted with this set of figures," said Prudential's chief executive, Peter Davis, in the statement.
"Sales are continuing to grow in our U.S. and Asia operations, while in the UK our new marketing and distribution initiatives continue to boost sales significantly."

The strong growth in single contribution sales reflects the continuing strong levels of investment in lump sum savings products, while customers still show comparatively less enthusiasm for longer-term commitment or regular contributions.

In the UK, the company's Prudence Savings Account and Prudence Bond brought in 461 million stg and 564 million respectively. The UK performance was also boosted by a one-off annuity sale of 500 million stg.
In the U.S., Prudential's Jackson National Life subsidiary saw single premium sales rise 60 percent to $2,780 million and annual premium sales increase by 25 percent to $50 million.
"Contributions" comprise life, pensions and investment products, while "premiums" are life and pension products only.
